name: England

flag.description: A white field with a red cross reaching to the edges, the Cross of St George.
flag.symbolism: The red cross on white is the emblem of St George, England's patron saint, and was in use as an English symbol by the late Middle Ages.

hook: England is the plain red cross on white: add four little crosses and you get Georgia, lay a gold cross over it and you get Guernsey.
trivia: The red St George's cross forms the upright cross at the centre of the Union Jack.
Genoa and Milan also use a red cross on white as their flag.
